name: Phoenix Mills Ltd.
about: The Phoenix Mills Limited engages in the operation and management of malls, construction of commercial and residential properties, and hotel business in India. The company operates in three segments: Property and Related Services, Hospitality services, and Residential Business. Its real estate asset portfolio consists of retail mall, commercial office, residential, and hospitality projects located in Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, Lucknow, Bareilly, Agra, Ahmedabad, Indore, Surat, Chandigarh, Thane, and Coimbatore. The company owns and operates hotels under The St. Regis and Courtyard by Marriott brand name in Mumbai and Agra. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~32% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~18% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 61 is near the top of its range over the last 3 years (median 54).
Trades at PE 61 vs sector median 41; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 33, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, most of the 37% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 20 → 61), not earnings growth (-1% a year).
